CustomField.label: Create Readout Task (retired)
CustomField.description: RETIRED and no longer read by any code. The review Task was replaced by a review Case (see Create_Readout_Case__c): a Case is queue-ownable without an org preference, carries the recipient comment thread natively, and gives one work item instead of two competing ones. The field is kept rather than deleted because GTM_Assessment_Config.Default still carries a value for it and dropping a custom metadata field is a destructive change; delete both together in a later cleanup.
